_doc: Named places with coordinates from repository files only (tools/build-gazetteer.mjs). resolution: exact = one feature carries the name; aggregate = centre of several name-bearing features; proxy = a related named feature stands for it. tier is inferred for every entry: no position here is a documented 1863 position of anything, it is where a name sits on the map. Never a point claim: sigma_m.
